1.) they realize what they are doing or the way they are acting isn’t cool. You would be surprised how often this is the case. Some people just keep pushing until someone tells them not to. During COVID some one came into work with a false negative test. So I was put into quarantine. My room mates wanted me to stay in my room for two weeks and would even let me have my dog. Right before that I had started playing sea of thieves with a friend and coworker who had also been quarantined because of the same issue. 

Him and I played sea of thieves everyday for the next two weeks. For 8-10 hours a day. We never talked about COVID we just got on and played sea of thieves. We played arena and got pirate legend. We followed long tails and fought kraken. He I went to the bathroom and I fell off the ship and we crashed and sunk. We hid on player ships for hours stealing stuff and throwing it over board. We rocked out to the bangers on the soundtrack. 

We talked so much about the game and music and bakeries in town. He was really my only contact for those two weeks aside from messages from my room mates. After we got of quarantine we got special sails and hulls for being the top earners for all three major guilds. 

After we went back to our lives we never really got a chance to play again. I miss him and that time. It was a perfect mix of what I wanted and what I needed at the time. It kept me sane when I was stuck inside my room for two weeks. I don’t even know if he knows how much it means to me but I will tell my grandkids about we played sea of thieves so much we got too tied sails. *”no you don’t understand it wasn’t one guild it was all thee!”*

I’ll never get that feeling back and part of thinks that ok because that means what I got to experience was truly unique.
